claims.claim_text: GPTZero's Hallucination Detector automatically identifies hallucinated sources and poorly supported claims within essays.
claims.evidence_span: GPTZero's Hallucination Detector automatically detects hallucinated sources and poorly supported claims in essays.

claims.claim_text: GPTZero's citation checker identifies fabricated references instantly, helping educators maintain academic integrity.
claims.evidence_span: Our citation checker identifies these hallucinated references instantly, helping educators maintain academic integrity without spending time on manual verification.

claims.claim_text: An AI hallucination is a response generated by artificial intelligence that contains false or misleading information presented as fact.
claims.evidence_span: In the field of artificial intelligence (AI), a hallucination or artificial hallucination (also called bullshitting, confabulation, delusion, or mirage) is a response generated by AI that contains false or misleading information presented as fact.

claims.claim_text: Symbolic artificial intelligence models do not produce hallucinations, unlike large language models.
claims.evidence_span: Symbolic artificial intelligence models generally do not produce hallucinations, unlike large language models.

claims.claim_text: Meta warned that BlenderBot 2 is prone to hallucinations defined as confident statements that are not true.
claims.evidence_span: In July 2021, Meta warned during its release of BlenderBot 2 that the system is prone to hallucinations, defined as confident statements that are not true.

claims.claim_text: AI hallucinations refer to statements made by the system which are factually incorrect, illogical, or not substantiated by any credible sources.
claims.evidence_span: AI hallucinations refer to statements made by the system which are either factually incorrect, illogical, or not substantiated by any credible sources but sound coherent and fluent on the face of it.

claims.claim_text: The survey aims to provide an extensive overview of current techniques employed to detect, verify, mitigate, or correct hallucinations in generative AI models.
claims.evidence_span: The present survey aims to provide an extensive overview of current techniques employed to detect, verify, mitigate, or correct hallucinations in generative AI models.

claims.claim_text: Datadog focuses on faithfulness since augmented generation techniques always retrieve a context as the tool of choice to adapt general-purpose models.
claims.evidence_span: Datadog focuses on faithfulness since augmented generation techniques, which always retrieve a context, remain the tool of choice to adapt general-purpose models to specific domains.

claims.claim_text: LLMs are better at guided summarization than complex reasoning when detecting hallucinations.
claims.evidence_span: A key principle in our prompt optimization approach is to recognize that LLMs are better at guided summarization than complex reasoning.

claims.claim_text: An AI hallucination occurs when a language model produces content that sounds authoritative and well-reasoned but is factually wrong or entirely made up.
claims.evidence_span: An AI hallucination is when a language model produces content that sounds authoritative and well-reasoned but is factually wrong or entirely made up.

claims.claim_text: Stanford research found that specialized legal AI tools hallucinate between 17% and 34% of the time.
claims.evidence_span: Stanford research found that even specialized legal AI tools hallucinate between 17% and 34% of the time.
